obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Determine the guideline amount of temporary maintenance after determining the parties' income.
obligations.quote: The court shall determine the guideline amount of temporary maintenance in accordance with the provisions of this paragraph after determining the income of the parties:
obligations.law_title: Establishes the provision of temporary maintenance in matrimonial actions, and directs the law revision commission to study the effects of divorce and maintenance

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Subtract 20 percent of the payee's income from 30 percent of the payor's income up to the income cap.
obligations.quote: The court shall subtract twenty percent of the income of the payee from thirty percent of the income up to the income cap of the payor.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the provision of temporary maintenance in matrimonial actions, and directs the law revision commission to study the effects of divorce and maintenance

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Multiply the sum of the payor's income up to the cap and all of the payee's income by 40 percent.
obligations.quote: The court shall then multiply the sum of the payor's income up to and including the income cap and all of the payee's income by forty percent.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the provision of temporary maintenance in matrimonial actions, and directs the law revision commission to study the effects of divorce and maintenance

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Subtract the payee's income from the amount derived by the 40 percent calculation.
obligations.quote: The court shall subtract the income of the payee from the amount derived from clause (b) of this subparagraph.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the provision of temporary maintenance in matrimonial actions, and directs the law revision commission to study the effects of divorce and maintenance

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: For payor income above the cap, determine the guideline amount up to the cap and any additional amount by weighing statutory factors.
obligations.quote: The court shall determine the guideline amount of temporary maintenance for that portion of the payor's income that is up to and including the income cap according to subparagraph one of this paragraph, and, for the payor's income in excess of the income cap, the court shall determine any additional guideline amount of temporary Maintenance
obligations.law_title: Establishes the provision of temporary maintenance in matrimonial actions, and directs the law revision commission to study the effects of divorce and maintenance

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Set forth in a written order the factors considered and the reasons for a decision on income above the cap.
obligations.quote: In any decision made pursuant to this subparagraph, the court shall set forth the factors it considered and the reasons for its decision.
obligations.law_title: Establishes the provision of temporary maintenance in matrimonial actions, and directs the law revision commission to study the effects of divorce and maintenance

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
obligations.action_summary: Determine the guideline duration of temporary maintenance by considering the length of the marriage.

obligations.law_title: Establishes the provision of temporary maintenance in matrimonial actions, and directs the law revision commission to study the effects of divorce and maintenance

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration

obligations.law_title: Establishes the provision of temporary maintenance in matrimonial actions, and directs the law revision commission to study the effects of divorce and maintenance

obligations.agency_full: Unified Court System / Office of Court Administration
